## Slate overview
There are two Conference USA games tonight. **This card was rerun on Wednesday with the new feedback loop** (calibration, closing line value, angle records and lessons), and it replaces Tuesday's early read.
- **Jacksonville State (3-2) at Kennesaw State (1-3):** JXST opened -3.5 and moved to -3 / -2.5 (ML -144 / +120). The total moved from 49.5 to 50.5, with 99% of the money on the over ([Bleacher Nation](https://www.bleachernation.com/picks/2026/10/04/jacksonville-state-vs-kennesaw-state-prediction-live-odds-stats-history-and-picks-october-7-2026/)).
- **New Mexico State (2-3) at FIU (2-2):** FIU opened -3.5 and moved to -6.5 (-108). 81% of the money and 67% of the tickets are on FIU ([Covers](https://www.covers.com/ncaaf/new-mexico-state-vs-florida-international-prediction-picks-odds-oct-7-2026)).

**What the feedback loop says:** we've won 44% against 56% predicted over 9 bets, so edges under 3 points don't get bet. The line-move angle is 1-0, the public-fade angle is 1-2, and we've beaten the close on only 1 of 5 picks.

## Best bets

### Kennesaw State +3 (-110) vs. Jacksonville State - 0.5 units
- **Win probability 56% vs. 52.4% implied.** Half a unit because our calibration is running cold.
- **The line moved toward the underdog.** It went from JXST -3.5 to -3 and then -2.5 at some books, off the key number. That's the same signal that worked on the Falcons (+2.5 closed +1.5 and won outright).
- **Projection support.** One model gives Kennesaw State a 57.9% chance to win outright ([Bleacher Nation](https://www.bleachernation.com/picks/2026/10/04/jacksonville-state-vs-kennesaw-state-prediction-live-odds-stats-history-and-picks-october-7-2026/)). The Owls' last two losses came by a combined 7 points. Amari Odom (17 TD, 7 rushing TD) gives them a QB who can keep up with Cam Cook (1,581 rushing yards, national leader) ([SI](https://www.si.com/betting/jacksonville-state-vs-kennesaw-state-prediction-odds-key-players-to-watch-college-football-week-6)).
- **Only at +3.** At +2.5 the edge falls under our threshold, so pass.

## Leans & passes
- **New Mexico State +6.5: dropped** (it was Tuesday's pick). The line moved 3 points toward FIU with 81% of the money, so we were betting against the move and would very likely have had negative closing line value. At -112 our edge is about 2 points, below the 3-point threshold. Model disagreement (Dimers FIU -4.5) is not enough against a move that size.
- **JXST/KSU over 50.5:** pass. With 99% of the money on the over, the price is inflated.

## Risks
- College injury news comes late. Check both teams before kickoff.
